author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 12/10/2018: MITK, XNET, LITB, MSFT, IBM, CSCO, AAPL, GOOG
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: +0.31%
AAPL: -1.05%
IBM: +0.30%
CSCO: +0.45%
GOOG: -0.54%
Technology stocks were mixed pre-bell Monday.
Moving stocks include:
(+) Mitek Systems ( MITK ), which was over 16% higher after ASG Technologies increased its acquisition offer for the software firm to $11.50 per share from $10.
(+) LightInTheBox Holding Co. ( LITB ) was up over 8% as it closed the acquisition of a 100% equity stake in Ezbuy Holding Co., a Singapore-based cross-border e-commerce platform.
(+) Xunlei ( XNET ) was gaining more than 4% after it announced a strategic partnership with China Mobile ( CHL ) subsidiary China Mobile IoT Company Ltd. to jointly develop Internet of Things (IoT) industry solutions using blockchain technology.
